comments.body:
Probably it would be smarter to look all around Europe for the research group that does the best work in this very specific field you have in mind, and then apply there. And then maybe your ideas may align with what they want to do. Also, if you bring your own funding (e.g. by applying for personal grants), you may be more free in what topic to pick.
Otherwise, you will just have to do the project you apply to, you cannot expect a prof to employ you for a project of your choosing.
comments.author: Laokon96
